note: Acceptance scenarios (Anthropic skill-creator convention; no standard runner yet).

evals.name: add-anchored-feedback
evals.prompt: Run /audit-feedback add attaching a comment to an exact text span on a page.
expect: item records an exact text anchor (page + quoted span or stable id), not 'somewhere on the page'
initial state = open, with author + timestamp

evals.name: resolve-keeps-the-record
evals.prompt: Run /audit-feedback resolve on an open item that a PR has now addressed.
expect: moves to a terminal state (resolved/wontfix/superseded) WITH a reason and a link to the change
the item stays in the record — it is closed-with-reason, never deleted (incident feedback-silent-delete)

evals.name: no-silent-delete
evals.prompt: Attempt to delete a resolved feedback item entirely.
expect: deletion is not allowed; deleted is not a valid state
state transitions are append-only, preserving the audit trail

evals.name: orphaned-anchor-flagged
evals.prompt: Run /audit-feedback list after a page edit removed the text an item was anchored to.
expect: the item with the now-orphaned anchor is surfaced/flagged, not silently lost
